risks.note: Increasing sophistication of cyber-attacks, data breaches and ransomware threats pose substantial risks to IT infrastructure and sensitive information - directly relevant since the Company runs collocation data centres, network support and cyber security offerings for clients.

Stricter data privacy laws and regulations such as GDPR and CCPA require heavy investment in compliance, with significant penalties for non-compliance; the Company serves clients across geographies through subsidiaries in Germany and China.
The fast pace of technological advancement can lead to obsolescence and requires continuous adaptation and investment to stay competitive.

Growing demand for skilled IT professionals means the industry faces challenges attracting and retaining top talent, leading to skill gaps; talent retention is also flagged as an industry-level headwind in the business outlook.

The Company faces an increasingly competitive landscape from domestic and international service providers, both large and small, while market saturation in certain segments can intensify competition and diminish margins, impacting profitability.
risks.risk: Competitive intensity, pricing pressure and market saturation

risks.note: Economic downturns or recessions can lead to reduced IT budgets, delayed investments and slower growth; changing customer spending patterns are separately flagged in the business outlook.
risks.risk: Economic uncertainty and client IT budget cuts

risks.note: The rupee has exhibited two-way movements reflecting global and domestic factors, with protracted geopolitical tensions, heightened volatility in global financial markets and elevated global sovereign bond yields cited as ongoing drivers.

Political instability, trade wars and regulatory changes in different regions can impact global operations and market access - relevant given overseas subsidiaries and international clients. The Company states it runs a well-defined and dynamic enterprise risk management (ERM) programme, governed by a comprehensive risk management policy and embedded in planning and review processes, to identify, record, track and mitigate such risks.
